record.body:
## Problem

The dashboard is organized by effort, and phases are only group headers inside the task table. There is no way to select a phase. Reaching another phase means moving the cursor to its header, unfolding `N earlier phases done`, and pressing Enter or `p`. The stepper looks like a phase picker but only expands finished titles, and it shows only the first in-progress phase when several run in parallel. Status tabs, counts, and progress cover the whole effort, so finished tasks crowd out the active ones. The Spec, Evidence, and Journal views planned for later phases are per phase and need a selected phase.

## Approach

Decisions: phase-selection-scope, phase-selector-keys, phase-sections (superseded: grouping only on All phases), quiet-header (superseded: the stepper becomes the selector), selection-follow, parallel-phase-default, wave-strip, finished-effort-toggle, activity-merge, ux-phase-split. Run as structured work: specification `phase-selector`, design `phase-selector`.

Each effort selects a phase, by default its current one. The stepper line becomes the selector: `[` and `]` step, `P` opens a filterable picker, and segments are clickable. The last stop is All phases, which is today's grouped table. The selected phase scopes the task table, status-tab counts, and progress bar. Needs you and Activity stay effort-wide. The selection follows the current phase until the user picks another. The selected phase shows a wave strip, and the wave column goes. Activity merges consecutive same-kind lines. Finished efforts hide behind `f` unless they have Needs you items. `?` shows the keys.

This phase edits the dashboard and does not change `contract/project-design.json` or `~/adaptive-artifacts`. It starts after `estimate-view` is on main, because both edit the phase header and task title code in `dashboard/app.py` and `dashboard/tasks.py`. It is the first of five phases: phase-selector, human-gates, spec-view, evidence-matrix, journal-view.

## Exit criteria

- Default selection, scoped counts, follow and pin, wave strip text, merged activity, and finished-effort hiding hold against seeded stores (model and task tests in `tests/test_dashboard_model.py` and `tests/test_dashboard_tasks.py`).
- `[`, `]`, `P`, clicks, `p`, `f`, and `?` behave as specified in a Textual pilot (`tests/test_dashboard_app.py`).
- `dashboard/bin/dashboard --once` prints the selector line and wave strip at the default selection (`tests/test_dashboard_integration.py`).
- The full suite passes.

payload.title: Select a phase: selector, scoped table, wave strip
